rules.sentence: M1b refers to a single metastatic focus outside the chest, often characterized as oligometastatic disease.
M1c denotes multiple metastatic sites outside the chest, reflecting widely metastatic disease.
The distinction between M1b and M1c carries important therapeutic implications, as patients with oligometastatic disease may benefit from local ablative therapy in addition to systemic treatment.
